title: AI Governance Risk Project and Program Management
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
As part of Enterprise Technology function, we are seeking Senior Program Manager / Associate Director to drive measurable business value through the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programs and transformation initiatives.
  
  
The role is responsible for end-to-end program leadership, governance, financial oversight, risk and dependency management, stakeholder alignment, and delivery assurance across business and technology environments. The position combines strategic thinking with practical execution, while leading teams and strengthening project and program management capability.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior Manager / Associate Director - Project & Program Management to lead strategic programs and enterprise transformation initiatives across the enablement services functions.
  
  
As a program leader, you will translate business priorities into practical roadmaps, integrated plans, governance structures, and measurable outcomes. You will work with senior stakeholders, clients, delivery teams, and partners to manage complexity, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain focus on value, quality, cost, and timelines.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings broad experience in program management, business transformation, service transitions, and managed services, together with strong financial, commercial, people leadership, and executive communication skills.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead complex, large-scale, cross-functional programs from initiation through execution, transition, and closure.
* Translate strategic objectives into program roadmaps, integrated delivery plans, milestones, governance structures, and measurable outcomes.
* Establish and strengthen PMO frameworks, delivery standards, executive reporting, decision forums, and delivery assurance mechanisms.
* Oversee program budgets, forecasts, resource plans, cost performance, and progress against approved business cases.
* Lead business transformation, operating model changes, process improvement, technology-enabled initiatives, service transitions, automation, and digital modernization.
* Establish effective risk, issue, dependency, change, quality, and escalation management practices.
* Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, clients, business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and strategic partners.
* Lead steering committees and executive reviews, communicate program performance and trade-offs, and resolve complex stakeholder and delivery challenges.
* Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, workstream leads, and geographically distributed teams.
* Drive operational readiness and the effective transition of solutions into managed services or business-as-usual operations where applicable.
* Use project and portfolio platforms, analytics, automation, KPIs, and dashboards to improve transparency, decision-making, predictability, and benefits tracking.
* Contribute to investment planning, commercial assessments, proposals, solutioning, and continuous improvement of delivery methods and reusable practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Science / Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically 18+ years of progressive experience in project and program management, PMO leadership, enterprise transformation, managed services, delivery or global operations.
* Proven experience leading complex programs with multiple workstreams, dependencies, senior stakeholders, and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong capability in program governance, integrated planning, financial management, resource planning, risk mitigation, delivery assurance, and executive reporting.
* Experience delivering business transformation, operating model change, service transition, process improvement, automation, or technology modernization initiatives.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders, facilitate decisions, manage ambiguity, and resolve complex delivery challenges.
* Experience leading and developing project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong business acumen, executive communication, negotiation, structured problem-solving, and change leadership skills.
* Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches, with the judgment to select and tailor methods to program needs.
* Experience using project and portfolio management tools such as Microsoft Project, Planview, Jira

**Ideally, you will also have**

* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, or an equivalent project, program, Agile, change, or service management certification.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, IT services, global business services, regulated industries, or a large enterprise environment.
* Experience contributing to business cases, commercial reviews, proposals, solutioning, or client development activities.
* Experience establishing PMO or delivery governance capabilities and improving project management maturity.

**What We Look For**
A strategic and delivery-focused leader who can connect business objectives with practical execution. Someone who combines strong program management discipline with commercial awareness, transformation experience, and sound judgment; builds trusted relationships; develops high-performing teams; and remains accountable for measurable outcomes in complex and changing environments.
  
  
**What Working At EY Offers**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland & the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies & sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills & insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Succesds as define by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: IT Service Excellence Manager
description:
**The role**

This is a new role, reporting directly to the Director of IT Services & Development, and sitting alongside our Head of Service Delivery (Run) as a peer. While Run owns day-to-day operations, you'll own the process, governance and measurement backbone that spans the function — as we move from six fragmented support platforms onto one.

You'll be the person who can answer, at any point, exactly how the service is performing, where the backlog sits, and what's being done about it — and who makes sure that answer keeps getting better, quarter on quarter.

**What we're looking for**

● Proven ITSM process and governance experience — ITIL 4 essential.

● Proven experience establishing ITIL-aligned frameworks and standards from scratch across a multi￾region service delivery organisation — not just operating within one that's already mature.

● Experience owning service catalogues and SLA/XLA design, including monthly reporting to

leadership.

● Experience with modern ITSM tooling and platforms, ideally through a migration or transformation programme.

● A track record of driving continual service improvement, not just running business-as-usual

operations.

● Comfortable operating in an influence-led way across teams you don't directly manage, to drive

process and governance improvements.

● Strong stakeholder and reporting skills — comfortable presenting service performance directly to IT leadership.

● Comfortable operating across a multi-brand, multi-region group, with colleagues and stakeholders across EMEA and APAC.

title: Client Relationship & Project Advisor | ArchPro | Kochi
description:
**Experience:**
1–4 Years

**Location:**
Ernakulam, Kerala (On-site)

**Joining:**
Within 30 Days

ArchPro is looking for a
**Client Relationship & Project Advisor**
to join our team in Kochi. This is a people-facing, client-oriented role for someone who genuinely enjoys speaking with people, understanding their requirements, and helping them navigate the early stages of their architecture and construction projects.

You will be responsible for handling clients who approach ArchPro, understanding their project requirements, communicating with them across calls and messages, explaining ArchPro’s approach and capabilities, and ensuring that every client interaction is professional, positive, and informative.

**About ArchPro:**

**ArchPro is a project delivery company, the one accountable for getting it built as designed. Projects are designed by the professionals; delivered by us. We run live residential and interior projects across multiple Indian cities, with our delivery operations anchored in Kochi. ArchPro brings together architecture, design, project management, execution, interiors, and other project delivery capabilities under one roof.**

**Role Overview:**

As a
**Client Relationship & Project Advisor**
, you will be one of the first points of contact for clients approaching ArchPro.

Your work will involve understanding who the client is, what they are looking to build, their project requirements, location, scale, budget, timeline, design expectations, and other relevant details. You will then help the client understand how ArchPro can approach their project and coordinate internally to take the conversation forward.

**This role requires someone who is highly articulate, energetic, approachable, positive, and genuinely interested in people and projects. You should be comfortable having detailed conversations about architecture, design, construction, budgets, timelines, and client requirements, while also being willing to continuously learn.**

**The ability to maintain a consistently positive and enthusiastic attitude while speaking with clients is extremely important. This role also involves responding to clients over text and maintaining a professional and helpful communication style throughout the client journey.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Handle incoming client enquiries**
  - Be the primary point of contact for clients approaching. ArchPro and ensure every enquiry receives a timely, professional, and positive response.
* **Understand the project and client requirements**
  - Have detailed conversations with clients to understand their project type, location, plot size, expected built-up area, budget, requirements, timeline, design expectations, and other relevant project information.
* **Explain ArchPro's approach**
  - Clearly communicate what ArchPro does, how our design and project delivery process works, and how different teams and professionals are involved in delivering a project.
* **Build client relationships**
  - Establish trust and rapport with clients through clear communication, active listening, genuine interest, and a positive approach.
* **Guide the initial conversation**
  - Help clients understand the next steps, clarify their questions, and ensure they have the right information before moving forward.
* **Maintain client communication**
  - Stay responsive to clients through calls, WhatsApp, email, and other communication channels, ensuring queries and follow-ups are handled properly.
* **Qualify and document projects**
  - Capture relevant project information accurately and maintain proper records so the internal team has a clear understanding of each opportunity.
* **Learn architecture & design**
  - Continuously develop your understanding of architecture, interiors, construction, materials, project costs, design processes, and project delivery.
* **Maintain ArchPro standards**
  - Ensure every client interaction reflects ArchPro's standards of professionalism, communication, transparency, design quality, and project delivery.

**Requirements:**

* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Malayalam and Hindi proficiency are preferred.
* Naturally energetic, enthusiastic, positive, and confident while interacting with people.
* Strong ability to listen, understand client requirements, and ask meaningful questions.
* Genuine interest in architecture, interiors, design, construction, and the built environment.
* Basic understanding of architecture; project scale, budget, construction, structure and materials.
* Comfortable communicating with clients through WhatsApp, calls, email, and other digital channels.
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
* Ability to maintain a positive and professional attitude consistently, including during challenging client conversations.
* Ability to understand and communicate information clearly without overpromising or misrepresenting project possibilities.
* Familiarity with Instagram, YouTube, and digital platforms is an advantage.
* Comfortable using AI and digital tools for research, communication, documentation, and client workflows.

**Qualification:**

* Degree or diploma in Architecture, Interior Design, Civil Engineering, Design, or any related field is preferred.
* Candidates from other educational backgrounds with a genuine interest in architecture, design, and construction may also be considered.
* 1–4 years of relevant experience in client relations, architecture, interiors, construction, design, hospitality, consulting, or other people-facing roles.
* Experience communicating with clients or working in a client-facing environment is preferred.

**Application:**

**Interested candidates are requested to share their resume.**

**If you genuinely enjoy speaking with people, are curious about how projects are designed and built, and can bring energy, clarity, and positivity to every client conversation, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst-Multiple Alliances - Supervising Associate - India
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title:**
GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst
  
  
**Job Summary:**
The GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst will operate from the GDS Program Operations CoE and provide structured operations, governance, stakeholder coordination, reporting, content management and execution support across multiple alliances within the broader Global Alliances and Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The role may support selected alliances on an ongoing basis while providing flexible, needs-based support to others in response to changing business priorities. The incumbent will help alliance leadership teams run effective, insight-led and scalable operating models by tracking priorities, managing operational cadence, improving process discipline and enabling timely execution across sell, build and deliver motions. Working closely with alliance, market, finance, contracts, training, BMC and enablement stakeholders, the role will strengthen delivery consistency, improve data and reporting quality, simplify ways of working and identify automation opportunities, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, enhance reporting narratives and improve operational outcomes.
  
  
**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Serve as the central operations and PMO support point for assigned alliance activities, ensuring priorities, workstreams, owners, timelines, risks, dependencies and follow-ups are clearly captured, tracked and progressed with discipline.
* Provide assigned alliance leadership teams with timely business insights through structured reporting, dashboards and executive-ready narratives covering sales, pipeline, opportunity tagging, partner-sourced and co-sell activity, prospect tracking, key GTM wins, book of business movements, partner program measures and other relevant performance indicators.
* Support governance cadence for leadership meetings, QBRs, planning forums and operational reviews by developing agendas, storyboarding content, coordinating inputs, preparing meeting materials, capturing actions and tracking closure.
* Maintain and continuously refresh alliance reference materials, SharePoint content, leadership-ready presentations, internal updates and other enablement assets to improve findability, consistency, relevance and adoption across stakeholder groups.
* Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams to develop, review and maintain alliance-related content, ensuring alignment with messaging standards, stakeholder expectations and partner program requirements.
* Program manage partner tools, portals and operational processes across assigned alliances, including access request tracking, issue resolution, adoption monitoring, certification and skills currency tracking, training coordination and tool administration support.
* Work with alliance investment, finance, legal and enablement teams to support applicable market development fund, co-investment and related funding processes across assigned alliances, including investment tracking, compliance monitoring, periodic reviews, documentation readiness, claims support and process adherence.
* Support alliance contract and governance activities, including initiation and tracking of localization of global agreements, program documentation, partner designation, distinction or specialization requirements, and related compliance actions in collaboration with the Ecosystem Contracts team and relevant business stakeholders.
* Partner with onshore alliance leaders and enablement contacts across assigned alliances on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, stakeholder mapping, partner offering or marketplace coordination, event or sponsorship coordination, training interventions and other priority initiatives as required.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve alliance operations processes through process mapping, documentation, issue analysis, control strengthening, data quality improvement and adoption of reusable templates and playbooks.
* Leverage automation and responsible AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to reduce repetitive manual activity, improve reporting turnaround time, support content drafting, enhance insight generation, improve follow-up tracking and enable scalable service delivery.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, communication plans and delivery commitments with clarity, responsiveness and strong service orientation across global and regional teams.

**Knowledge and Skill Requirements:**

* Strong understanding of alliance, ecosystem or partner program operations, preferably in a professional services, technology, consulting, shared services, GCC or global capability center environment; exposure to multiple technology partners, enterprise software, cloud, data, CRM, workflow automation, low-code platforms or digital transformation ecosystems would be advantageous.
* Working knowledge of sales, revenue, pipeline, opportunity lifecycle, partner program metrics, GTM motions, co-sell or referral activity, partner distinctions, specialization requirements and performance reporting, with the ability to interpret data and convert it into concise executive-ready insights.
* Strong program and project management skills, including planning, tracking, governance cadence management, risk and dependency monitoring, action follow-up and management of multiple priorities with competing deadlines.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, workflow tools or other reporting and collaboration platforms considered an advantage.
* Experience with continuous improvement, process simplification and operational excellence, including process mapping, SOP development, control documentation, audit readiness, root cause analysis and issue resolution.
* Ability to identify automation opportunities and apply digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, reporting quality, follow-up discipline, knowledge management and stakeholder experience.
* Practical exposure to generative AI tools for research, content development, summarization, insight generation, workflow support and productivity enhancement; preferable exposure to Agentic AI concepts, AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
* Strong stakeholder management capability, with the ability to engage senior onshore stakeholders, anticipate needs, manage expectations and build trusted advisor relationships across functions and geographies.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including business writing, executive presentation development, narrative building and the ability to create high-quality content with limited initial guidance.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, research capability and attention to detail, with the ability to work across multiple teams to drive practical and timely resolution.
* Experience working in virtual, matrixed and multi-geography environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline and a global mindset.
* Knowledge of EY and GDS operations, organization structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts for internal candidates; Big 4, consulting, technology or leadership support exposure for external candidates would be preferred.

**Job Requirements:**
**Academics:**

* MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; degree in business, technology, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline preferred.
* Project/program management certification, process improvement certification, or relevant alliance, partner program, technology partner or enterprise software certification would be an added advantage.
* Relevant certifications or digital badges in generative AI, responsible AI, AI-enabled productivity, prompt engineering, automation, analytics, or Agentic AI concepts would be highly desirable, particularly where they demonstrate practical application in business operations, reporting, process improvement, knowledge management, or stakeholder enablement.

**Experience:**

* 8+ years of progressive, relevant experience in alliance operations, program management, business operations, sales/GTM enablement, ecosystem support, consulting operations, technology partner enablement or enterprise software partner operations; experience supporting multiple alliances or technology partner ecosystems would be preferred.
* Demonstrated experience supporting senior stakeholders in a matrixed, global environment, with exposure to governance routines, executive reporting, process coordination, and cross-functional delivery.
* Experience in reporting, dashboarding, content development, stakeholder tracking, or operational improvement initiatives would be beneficial.

**Working Hours:**

* Working hours will be aligned with the applicable US Central or Eastern Time Zones, based on stakeholder coverage and business requirements.

**Note:**
This job description is intended as a guide to reflect the principal functions of the job. However, it is not an all-inclusive listing of the required job functions and functions may vary depending on business requirements, on the geographic location of the job and/or the manager. Further, the job description is subject to change at the discretion of management.

title: GDS Mistral Alliance Operations Strategist-Associate Director
description:

**Function**
: GDS ES Growth & Innovation

Strategic Leadership
  
  
**Sub Function:**
GDS Alliances Partner Operations CoE
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY GDS Growth & Innovation enables EY’s strategic ecosystem relationships, market activation priorities and alliance-led growth programs. The Mistral alliance brings together EY’s industry, transformation, risk and responsible AI capabilities with Mistral AI’s enterprise AI platform, open and commercial models, and flexible deployment approaches. The alliance requires a senior operations leader who can connect joint strategy, governance, commercialization, enablement, investment oversight and multi-geo execution through a disciplined global operating model.
  
  
The GDS Mistral Alliance Operations Strategist is an Associate Director-level role responsible for defining and driving the business management, governance and execution strategy for the EY–Mistral alliance. The role serves as the operational counterpart to global alliance leadership, translating joint priorities into scalable plans, measurable outcomes and coordinated execution across go-to-market, solution development, sales activation, delivery readiness, marketing, enablement and alliance investment programs.
  
  
Operating from GDS, this role will orchestrate consistent support across regions and service lines while maintaining clear interfaces with EY and Mistral stakeholders. It combines strategic planning, alliance business management, program leadership and executive influence with working knowledge of enterprise generative AI, sovereign and private deployment considerations, model and platform lifecycle management, responsible AI, security, regulatory obligations and the fast-moving economics of AI solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously mature the global operating model, governance framework and business management processes for the EY–Mistral alliance.
* Translate joint alliance priorities into annual and quarterly operating plans, execution roadmaps, decision rights, milestones and measurable business outcomes.
* Design and run executive governance forums, steering committees, pipeline and performance reviews, and working cadences involving EY and Mistral leadership.
* Develop alliance scorecards and executive insight packs covering pipeline, bookings, influenced revenue, solution maturity, client adoption, delivery capacity, enablement, investments, risks and outcomes.
* Coordinate joint go-to-market planning, account activation, campaigns, events, thought leadership, case studies and priority pursuits across regions and sectors.
* Support the lifecycle of Mistral-enabled offerings from ideation and business case through solution approval, readiness, launch, field adoption and performance improvement.
* Build repeatable GDS services, playbooks, intake processes, service levels, knowledge assets and escalation paths for alliance, sales and delivery stakeholders.
* Coordinate capability building across Mistral AI models, APIs, enterprise platform capabilities, agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, model customization and cloud, VPC, on-premises or edge deployment patterns.
* Embed responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, intellectual property, data residency, model risk and applicable regulatory considerations into alliance operating processes, with specialist teams retaining accountability for formal approvals.
* Maintain visibility of model, platform and commercial changes; assess operational impacts and coordinate updates to enablement, offerings, controls, contracts and stakeholder communications.
* Manage alliance investments, forecasts, budgets, resource plans, benefits realization and supporting evidence in collaboration with finance, commercial and alliance leadership.
* Orchestrate execution across alliance, technology, consulting, industry, risk, legal, procurement, finance, marketing, sales and delivery teams in a complex global matrix.
* Identify bottlenecks, dependencies and execution risks early, establish remediation plans and provide decision-ready recommendations to alliance leaders.
* Drive automation and data quality improvements across pipeline reporting, governance workflows, knowledge management, enablement tracking and leadership reporting.
* Coach matrixed contributors across operations, PMO, reporting and enablement support to improve quality, accountability, responsiveness and delivery discipline.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Senior-level experience in technology alliance operations, AI or data ecosystem programs, business management, PMO, commercialization or strategic execution.
* Working knowledge of the enterprise generative AI landscape, including foundation models, APIs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, customization, evaluation and production deployment.
* Ability to convert rapidly changing technology, product and market developments into clear alliance priorities, operating implications and executable plans.
* Strong understanding of partner governance, joint business planning, go-to-market activation, pipeline management, offering lifecycle and investment governance.

* Strong analytical capability and disciplined use of metrics to diagnose performance, identify opportunities and recommend corrective action.
* Experience designing scalable processes and service models for GDS or a comparable global delivery environment.
* Comfort using approved AI, analytics and automation tools to improve research, reporting, meeting productivity, workflow execution and knowledge reuse.
* People leadership and matrix management skills, including coaching, prioritization, quality oversight and capability development.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* University degree required; qualification in business, technology, engineering, computer science, data and analytics, finance, operations or a related discipline preferred.
* MBA, postgraduate qualification or recognized certification in AI, data, cloud, project or program management, process improvement or technology management would be an advantage.
* 15+ years of relevant experience, including substantial leadership responsibility in technology alliances, AI or data programs, strategic operations, commercialization, global PMO or business management.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional global programs in a matrixed professional services, technology, platform or ecosystem environment.
* Experience partnering with senior executives and technical leaders on joint strategy, governance, performance management and decision support.
* Practical experience with alliance business plans, pipeline and revenue reporting, offering or solution governance, enablement, investments and operating cadences.

* Experience supporting sovereign AI, regulated-industry or sensitive-data use cases where control, residency, security, traceability and deployment choice are material.
* Understanding of open-weight and commercial model ecosystems, licensing considerations, model evaluation, inference economics and build-versus-buy decisions.
* Exposure to AI use cases such as intelligent document processing, knowledge assistants, coding, multilingual solutions, multimodal AI and agentic workflows.
* Experience building or scaling partner enablement, certification, field activation, solution incubation or technical community programs.
* Exposure to professional services operating models and alliance-led growth across consulting, technology transformation, risk or managed services.
* Experience managing GDS or global delivery teams that support multiple regions through standardized services and locally adaptable execution.

**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft 365 tools including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, Planner, Forms and Loop.
* Power BI, Power Query, Power Pivot, Power Automate, Power Apps and approved dashboarding, workflow and AI-enabled productivity solutions.

We are looking for a commercially aware, technology-fluent Associate Director who can turn the ambition of the EY–Mistral alliance into coordinated global execution. The ideal candidate will combine alliance operations depth, executive stakeholder confidence, AI ecosystem awareness, governance discipline, financial acumen and GDS leadership, while remaining comfortable with rapid product evolution, responsible AI expectations and the sovereign, secure and flexible deployment needs of enterprise clients.

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that advances EY’s growth strategy. Within Growth & Innovation, GDS teams enable alliances, ecosystems, go-to-market programs, technology-enabled growth and business insights across global locations. In this role, you will help shape the operating foundation of the EY–Mistral alliance, collaborate with senior global and technical stakeholders, enable responsible enterprise AI growth and build scalable GDS services that connect strategy with market and delivery execution.

8-14 years of experience in outsourcing coordination, material control, stores, commercial operations, or production coordination.

title: CRM Operations Coordinator – Online Gaming
description:
We are looking for a CRM Operations Coordinator to support the execution and optimization of promotional campaigns, audience segmentation, lifecycle management, and casino content operations across our Betly Casino and Sportsbook brands.The role will be responsible for building, testing, deploying, and monitoring CRM campaigns, as well as identifying audience and promotional opportunities that drive player engagement, loyalty, and incremental value. In addition, the role will serve as an executional point of contact for casino content configuration, including the integration and deployment of new games across platforms and jurisdictions.The ideal candidate will be highly organized, analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced online gaming environment while coordinating with Marketing, Acquisition, Compliance, Casino, and external partners.

* Responsibilities:CRM & Campaign OperationsDevelop strong working knowledge of CRM, bonusing, audience-building, segmentation, and lifecycle management tools, and leverage these tools to support promotional effectiveness and profitability.
* Build and manage audience segments, lifecycle journeys, automations, and A/B tests; routinely monitor performance and optimize campaigns for efficiency and engagement.
* Build, test, schedule, deploy, and analyze promotional campaigns, boosts, loyalty offers, and other player engagement initiatives.
* Monitor player activity, value, preferences, and lifecycle segments to identify changes in audience composition, segment growth, migration, and engagement opportunities.
* Provide actionable insights and performance observations to leadership to support CRM and promotional planning.
* Partner with Marketing and other relevant teams to understand player behavior across channels and identify opportunities to deliver more relevant, cohesive, and personalized content and offers.
* Coordinate the scheduling, testing, deployment, and performance analysis of outbound communications, including Rich Inbox, SMS, email, and mobile push notifications.
* Collaborate with the Acquisition team to identify opportunities to leverage lookalike audiences, optimize customer journeys, and improve conversion and retention.
* Ensure all CRM campaigns and communications comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and established governance standards.
* Follow quality-control processes to ensure the accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and validity of player data, campaign configurations, and promotional offers.

* Qualifications & Experience:2+ years of experience in CRM, marketing operations, campaign operations, or a related role; experience in online gaming, iGaming, sportsbook, or online casino is preferred.
* 1+ year of experience working with marketing analytics, customer segmentation, campaign performance analysis, or a related area.
* Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, audience segmentation, campaign management, or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret gaming, customer, and campaign data and translate insights into practical business actions.
* Ability to collect, organize, analyze, and present business performance metrics to management and other stakeholders.
* Strong project management, coordination, and organizational skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-paced and changing environment.
* Working knowledge of the online sportsbook and iCasino industry, including player journeys, wager types, user flows, casino products, and applicable gaming concepts.
* Familiarity with a range of casino games and their basic rules and mechanics.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams, vendors, and external partners.
* Role Requirements:Ability to participate in integration and vendor calls, which are typically scheduled before 12:00 PM EST.
* Ability to maintain a minimum of 3 hours of working-time overlap with the Director of Casino.
* Comfortable working in a remote environment and collaborating with teams across different time zones.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with campaign configurations, game launches, player data, and regulatory requirements.

**Experience:**
10–13 years
  
  
**Role Overview:**
The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy & Transformation practice. This leadership role combines hands-on cloud and AI platform architect expertise with consulting excellence, driving end-to-end AI platform implementation, infrastructure modernization and enterprise deployment programs while managing senior client relationships and CxO engagements. The position demands deep technical implementation skills in AI platform and infrastructure engineering, multi-cloud architecture, automation and deployment engineering, MLOps enablement and operationalization of AI workloads alongside proven program leadership across industries like BFSI, manufacturing and regulated sectors.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering and Architecture Leadership

+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
+ Architect scalable cloud-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
+ Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
+ Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
+ Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
+ Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
+ Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.

* Client & Stakeholder Management

+ Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
+ Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
+ Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
+ Build trusted relationships through hands-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption

* Cloud, Automation & Deployment Engineering Leadership

+ Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
+ Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
+ Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
+ Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
+ Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
+ Implement release engineering practices including blue-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
+ Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.

* MLOps, Data Pipelines & Operationalization Leadership

+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
+ Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
+ Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud-native data services.
+ Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
+ Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service-level performance.
+ Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise-grade deployments.
+ Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

* Asset and Accelerator Development

+ Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
+ Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
+ Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

* Business Development & GTM Initiatives

+ Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
+ Develop industry-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
+ Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.

* Program Governance & Delivery Excellence

+ Oversee end-to-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
+ Manage cross-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
+ Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.

* Practice Development & Team Leadership


+ Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
+ Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
+ Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**
**Education:**

* B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).

**Core Technical Expertise (Hands-on Implementation Required):**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation & Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering & Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming & APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security & Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.

* AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty / AWS DevOps Engineer / AWS Solutions Architect

* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications

* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).

* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi-cloud architecture programs.

* Exceptional technical storytelling for CxO audiences.

title: Senior Project Architect
description:
**Company Description**
AE7 is a multi-disciplinary design firm that emphasizes a holistic approach to architecture and the built environment. The studio brings together architects, planners, landscape architects, interior designers, engineers, visualizers, and project and construction managers to deliver integrated solutions. AE7 focuses on creating meaningful community focal points and planning destinations that enhance how people live, work, and visit. The firm supports projects from initial concept and planning through construction completion, helping clients realize both their overall vision and key project milestones. Team members collaborate across disciplines, offering creative problem-solving strategies tailored to each project’s challenges and opportunities.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Project Architect is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi, responsible for leading the design and technical development of complex architectural projects. This position oversees project documentation, coordinates with internal teams and external consultants, and ensures that design intent is accurately translated into construction documents and submittals. Day-to-day tasks include guiding BIM model production, reviewing drawings and specifications, managing design revisions, and supporting compliance with applicable codes and sustainability standards. The Senior Project Architect will mentor team members, participate in client meetings, and collaborate with project managers to align schedules, budgets, and deliverables. The role requires proactive problem-solving, clear communication, and consistent attention to quality throughout all project phases.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong architectural design and technical skills, with proven experience in Architecture and project documentation across multiple phases.
* Demonstrated ability to manage Submittals, including review, coordination, and communication with contractors and consultants.
* Proficiency in Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools and workflows, with experience leading BIM-based design and documentation processes.
* Knowledge of sustainability standards and frameworks, including Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) or comparable certifications.
* Solid Project Management capabilities, including planning, coordination, schedule management, and risk mitigation for multi-disciplinary teams.
* Professional degree in Architecture and registration/licensure (or eligibility) preferred.
* Experience delivering medium to large-scale projects, ideally within multi-disciplinary or international design practices.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor junior staff and work effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Familiarity with local building codes, regulations, and construction practices in Kochi and the broader region is an advantage.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Manager Specialized:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Manager to lead large‑scale CRM and Power Platform initiatives, drive technical excellence, and manage high‑performing delivery teams. This role combines strategic oversight, architecture leadership, and people management to deliver scalable, high‑quality solutions that enable business transformation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the technical design, architecture, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery across D365 modules such as Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service, with accountability for quality and outcomes.
* Manage and mentor a team of developers, leads, and technical consultants, providing direction, performance feedback, and career development support.
* Collaborate closely with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Oversee development of custom plugins, workflows, integrations, and extensions using C#, JavaScript, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Power Platform technologies.
* Establish and enforce development standards through code reviews, design governance, testing strategies, and solution validation.
* Drive solution scalability, security, and performance by overseeing system architecture, integration patterns, and optimization efforts.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, scope, and resource utilization to ensure on‑time and within‑budget delivery.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, integration designs, and deployment standards.
* Act as a senior technical advisor to stakeholders, clearly articulating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong leadership experience managing technical teams in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform delivery environments.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM customization, extensibility, and solution architecture.
* Solid hands‑on understanding of C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and integration patterns (Azure and Power Platform).
* Proven experience delivering complex, enterprise‑scale CRM implementations.
* Strong grasp of Agile delivery models, estimation, planning, and governance.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive‑level presentation skills.
* Strategic mindset with strong problem‑solving, decision‑making, and prioritization capabilities.
* Developed and customized AI Copilots and agents using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 CRM, integrating workflows, Dataverse, and APIs to support intelligent automation and conversational experiences.

**<< Ideally, you’ll also>>**
**The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:**

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory

+ Copilot Studio
+ Dynamics 365 Project Operations
+ Dynamics 365 Field Service
+ Dynamics 365 Contact Center

**<< What we look for>>**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7+ years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation, with at least 1 year in a managerial or leadership role.
* Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, compliance, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience managing budgets, delivery risk, and resource planning for complex programs.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and retain high‑performing technical teams.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: UK EBP Supervisor
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Engagement Business Partner – Supervising Associate**
The Engagement Business Partner (EBP) is a finance professional with comprehensive knowledge of systems, processes, and policies. In this internal role, the EBP acts as the Finance single point of contact, collaborating closely with client-serving engagement teams to enable the successful delivery of engagements across the full engagement lifecycle, from opportunity creation to final record archiving. Please note: this is not a technical accounting role.
  
  
**The opportunity**
As a senior Engagement Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in supporting client-serving teams by ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all engagement lifecycle activities. The main components of this role are:
  
  

* Serving as the Finance single point of contact for Engagement Partners and Managers, offering guidance and overseeing all aspects of the Opportunity Engagement Lifecycle (OEL).
* Overseeing the completion of OEL tasks by delegating to Centres of Excellence (CoEs), and monitoring progress to ensure timely delivery.
* Proactively managing financial and quality related risks across your engagement portfolio, intervening where needed to provide strategic advice to uplift the compliance and revenue stability of your portfolio.
* Ensure compliance with service line specific policies and parameters.
* Supporting the annual external audit process.

This is a dynamic and rewarding role that contributes to profitable growth and high-quality client service.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Manage a portfolio of client opportunities and engagements, acting as the Finance single point of contact for the Engagement Partners with complex portfolios.
* Manage the professional development, coaching and upskilling of other EBPs in the team.
* Oversee team resourcing, proactively tracking joiners, leavers, and movers, and ensuring coverage of Partner portfolios during periods of leave or absence.
* Coordinate with client servers and CoEs to:

+ Apply knowledge of service line specific OEL policies and guidelines to ensure compliance across the OEL lifecycle.
+ Monitor and advise on risk assessment and compliance processes.
+ Advise on pricing models and engagement budgets.
+ Assess financial implications of engagement structures and budgets.
+ Support and challenge the Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) processes and related financial updates.
+ Support the portfolio’s working capital activity.

* Provide challenge and best practice insights to client servers where required such as through optimal margin, pricing plans or engagement structures.
* Upskill and share knowledge with client servers on OEL best practice, standards and tools.
* Develop a diverse network of relationships across Finance and non-Finance stakeholders to provide holistic Finance support for Engagement Partners and escalate queries beyond remit to other functional experts within Finance (e.g. PFAs).
* Review work performed by CoEs for accuracy and take ownership of OEL tasks when urgent needs arise.
* Seek to understand client-server needs, demands, and the nuances of the specific Service Line to deepen insights and strategic thinking.
* Share best practices across the EBP group to drive consistency and excellence.
* Engage with CoE Managers to flag issues, trends or knowledge required for CoE upskilling.
* Provide subject matter expertise in delivering training on OEL best practices for CoEs.
* Support continuous improvement through identifying opportunities for innovation and automation.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Deliver with pace ensuring activities are executed accurately in a fast-moving environment.
* Ability to engage proactively with Engagement Partners to anticipate upcoming needs and ensure OEL requirements are met on time.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a good understanding of the client server perspective and ability to build relationships with them.
* Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
* Excellent analytical and commercial acumen, with high attention to detail.
* Take ownership of monthly activities, driving progress and proactively managing business outcomes to meet deadlines and performance targets.
* Quick learner with a proactive approach and eager to share knowledge with others.
* Ability to translate complex technical system language into business-relevant terms.
* Skilled listener with sound judgment and the ability to escalate appropriately.
* Ability to lead others and support team development.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A minimum of two to three years’ experience in a client-facing or finance-related role within a professional services or corporate environment.
* Experience managing stakeholders and delivering high-impact client service.
* Ability to lead others in hybrid and fast-paced environments.
* Used to working in a fast-paced environment with a strong work ethic.
* Ability to build relationships with people at all levels within the firm.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
* Adaptability and resilience in fast-paced environments.

**What We Look For**
Highly motivated, good communicators who can establish credibility with client servers and convey financial impacts in business language back to client servers. You will also need to be a team player who is not only looking to enhance their own career but recognises the value in strengthening the team.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with MyReward you can select benefits that suit your needs, including holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. In addition, you will benefit from:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll have access to EY’s world-class learning offerings, on-the-job coaching, and structured development programmes designed to deepen your expertise, broaden your perspective, and help you grow into the next stage of your career.
* Success as defined by you: Define what success looks like for you, and we’ll provide the tools and flexibility to help you achieve it.
* Transformative leadership: Gain the insights, coaching, and confidence to lead with purpose and impact.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**Please note:**
Prior to finalising your application, you will be asked to provide personal information across several dimensions of diversity and inclusiveness. The information you provide is kept entirely confidential and will not be used to evaluate your candidacy. We collect this data to help us analyse our recruitment process holistically and implement actions that promote diversity and inclusiveness. While optional, we encourage you to provide this information to hold us accountable towards our goal of building a better working world. Read more about our commitment to diversity & inclusiveness here. We ask because it matters!
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Capital Markets Techno-Functional Business Analyst (Senior Consultant level) with experience in Capital Markets, Treasury, and Financial Markets transformation programs. The role requires a blend of business analysis, functional consulting, technology understanding, and stakeholder management capabilities to support platform implementation, integration, migration, and modernization initiatives across Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Risk, Finance, and Operations functions. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, support testing, and drive the delivery of complex change programs across global financial institutions.

**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Engage with business, operations, risk, finance, and technology stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, process walkthroughs, stakeholder interviews, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Produce high-quality BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.
* Perform gap analysis, impact assessments, process reviews, and future-state operating model design.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability between business requirements, solution design, testing activities, and implementation deliverables.
